note: Every outcome a person's traits should shape outside a choice between options, the engine that owns it, and whether that engine reads the trait in play. The trait-wiring matrix (scripts/traits/trait-wiring-matrix.ts) joins these rows with the researched effect sizes in data/research/trait-effect-sizes.json. Outcome-web links are not listed here: their personality moderators belong to the outcome web.

outcomes.title: Traits drawn to real norms by age and sex
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/opening-personality.ts:1 (latent standard scores with sourced NEO facet age and sex differences, cut at 10/20/40/20/10)

outcomes.title: Traits correlate with each other as in real people
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/opening-personality.ts:73 (registered correlated pairs) and ANCHORED loadings at :31

outcomes.title: Children resemble their parents
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/births-people.ts:102 draws a newborn from its parents' inherited parts (regenerated from the seed, the same parts the opening drew); measured parent-child correlation in two drawn places (buildBenchWorld seeds herit1 and herit2, 78 and 192 pairs): 0.03 to 0.34 by dimension, mean 0.18, against 0.20 to 0.28 expected from a heritability of 0.40 (Vukasovic & Bratko 2015)
outcomes.note: Counted newborns are seeded without their parents' parts: SG-PW8-counted-newborn-temperament.

outcomes.title: Traits change slowly with age (maturity)
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/modules/trait-change.ts:249 (each birthday moves the hidden scores along the opening age curves; counted people are caught up at fill-in, SG-TRAITS-counted-no-maturity)

outcomes.title: Traits shift after life events (job loss, marriage, bereavement)
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/modules/trait-change.ts:185 (a layoff, an eviction or a death in the family moves the emotional-stability traits 0.1 SD; data/trait-change.json)

outcomes.title: Resting stress by temperament
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/resting-stress.ts:115 (brooding raises, calm lowers) and src/core2/emotion.ts appraisal weights sized from Bolger and Schilling 1991 (appraisalDistressTraitWeight, appraisalBroodingTraitWeight in parameters.json)

outcomes.title: How strongly a person feels an event
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/emotion.ts:151 (recorded trait scales the appraisal multiplier)

outcomes.title: An aide's work quality and learning rate
How qualified a resident is for an appointed post
An ordinary worker's performance at work
outcomes.why: An ordinary worker has no performance record once hired: nothing reads conscientiousness for output, discipline or promotion (Barrick & Mount 1991, rho 0.22).
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/modules/jobs.ts:1679 employers rank applicants by fit, which reads the applicant's reliability (jobsFitReliabilityWeight)

outcomes.title: Promotion and pay by temperament
outcomes.why: Pay is the job's own rate (src/core2/modules/jobs.ts:2679); no raise or promotion reads the worker's traits (Gensowski 2018: 16.7% of lifetime earnings per SD of conscientiousness).
outcomes.evidence: Through hiring: reliability raises an applicant's fit (src/core2/modules/jobs.ts:1679), so reliable people are hired sooner

outcomes.title: Health behaviors (smoking, drinking, exercise, checkups)
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/condition-pack.ts:191 (who holds substance use disorder and chronic lung disease in the opening) and src/core2/modules/health.ts:307 (people who join later); Bogg and Roberts 2004

outcomes.title: Illness and death risk by conscientiousness
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/modules/health.ts:427 (strain builds at exp(slope x conscientiousness) over the opening mean); Kern and Friedman 2008

outcomes.title: Making friends and acquaintances
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/closeness.ts temperedHours (relationships.warm-to): a contact's hours count by both people's warmth; read by src/core2/state.ts relationship() at every change of a tie; test src/core2/closeness.traits.test.ts

outcomes.title: Arguments and grudges
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/closeness.ts temperedHours (relationships.fall-out): a quarrel's lost hours (a confrontation, src/core2/modules/drives.ts; an unrewarded bribe, src/core2/modules/corruption.ts) count by both people's hold-on lean; test src/core2/closeness.traits.test.ts

outcomes.why: No engine forms or ends a partnership in play; the partnership items in the pool are gated on core family-link work.

outcomes.why: No engine forms or ends a partnership in play; the partnership items in the pool are gated on core family-link work.

outcomes.title: How a person copes with hardship (job loss, debt, eviction)
outcomes.evidence: src/core2/emotion.ts:257 marks the part of a layoff's, an eviction's or a missed payment's stress that a hardship put there (Affect.hardship; kinds in content.json hardshipEventKinds), and src/core2/modules/credit.ts:1106 gives a missed loan payment the layoff's Holmes and Rahe size; src/core2/trait-decisions.ts:321 hardshipStress reads it, decayed to the day, for the three coping decisions: src/core2/jobs-benefits.ts:193 filingDecision (jobs-benefits.file-claim, weight 1.0 from Whittaker et al. 2010), src/core2/modules/credit.ts:859 personalBorrowingDecision (credit.borrow, 0.8 from Sullivan 2008 and the move and claim sizes) and src/core2/modules/moves.ts:467 pushesOf (moves.move-away, 0.6 from Huttunen, Moen and Salvanes 2018); rows outcome.hardship-coping in data/research/trait-effect-sizes.json, tests src/core2/hardship-coping.traits.test.ts. Played year (buildBenchWorld, twoLevel, ordinary world; people a hardship reaches join the focus so their reasons are saved), West Charlotte, Vermont (place key 5079335, seed 64be33aef753): person_ad57aafdf2c936e0 missed two loan payments (event:credit.payment-missed:loan:household_60e7e426583b8bdd:2025-04-01:2025-06-01, ...:2025-07-01), was evicted 2025-07-11 (event:housing.eviction:eviction:lease:household_60e7e426583b8bdd:2025-06-06) and left the next day, person.moved-away:person_ad57aafdf2c936e0:2025-07-12, whose reasons name push:hardshipStress 0.141; person_fb4d37fdd3a0fee6, evicted 2025-10-11 (event:housing.eviction:eviction:lease:household_60e0d826583558cb:2025-09-06) and leaning as far as a lean goes toward staying (-1.00 against the other's +0.35), stayed: pulls row person_fb4d37fdd3a0fee6 names the same push (0.163). Claim: claim:person_0116fddb7f83a1b9:2025-09-01 after event:work.job-lost:2025-09-01:work-relationship_a81aa18604d082e4 names hardshipStress 0.395. Loan: Clara City, Minnesota (place key 2711548, seed 7a716dab6cbf), application:2025-11-01:household_f29ac4737580f24d names hardshipStress 0.317 after the eviction of 2025-10-28. A counted person reads it at the day of their layoff claim only (SG-TRAITS-counted-hardship-stress).
